semantic_contract.is_jailed: Direct source Reader.IsJailed(r, offender) is true at r=E and false at r=E+1. A stored jail slot is not deleted when time expires.
semantic_contract.list: EndBlock CleanupJailedValidators reads current storage and removes the offender at current block E because it retains only jail_block > currentBlock. Preserve the full list Put, even if roots or list contents duplicate prior values.
semantic_contract.individual_eligibility: GetEligibleVoteCount and IsEligible apply jail exclusion only when the reader block activates Cacti. Cacti is inactive for this entire run; individual votes must follow actual stake and policy and must not be forced to zero due to Magnolia jail.
semantic_contract.total_eligibility: TotalEligibleVoteCount subtracts vote counts for the delayed jailed list without a Cacti guard in both pinned Go readers. Compare this distinct behavior, including restoration after delayed list removal; do not infer it from individual votes.
semantic_contract.reward_scope: Execute real native rewards and actual scheduler order for all periods. This qualifies duration and state transitions, not an invented jail reward penalty. Planner inputs must follow actual delayed readers.

request_assertions.proof_visibility: At historical head P+4 delayed state P-1 has no proof jail; at P+5 delayed state P contains jail scalar E and offender list. At P itself the historical getter still reads P-5.
request_assertions.expiry_visibility: At historical head E+4 delayed state E-1 still contains offender; at head E+5 delayed state E has empty offender list but retained jail scalar E. At head E+6 delayed state E+1 still has scalar E and no offender. Direct IsJailed at reader E is true and at E+1 is false.
request_assertions.scalar_and_proof: Check exact persistent jail scalar and proof marker at E-1,E,E+1,E+5,E+6,E+7, current and retained readers. No deletion assertion for these slots.
request_assertions.reader_facts: At each table head also record direct delayed IsJailed, individual eligibility, total eligibility and actual storage factory coordinates. These are separate reader checks, not fabricated ABI methods.
request_assertions.api_scopes: For each of36 head/method requests retain full call and fresh repeat, three estimate caps (500000, actual used gas, max(used-1,0)), every actual estimate probe in order, standalone trace and trace_sequence. Each invocation has a fresh native session and its own inputs/outputs/raw reads/writes. Trace at head+1 does not inherit the call delayed coordinate; record actual origin and factory coordinates. Preserve ABI bytes, errors, gas, logs, effective nonce and mutated input.
request_assertions.mutation: All historical calls/probes/traces leave committed root and physical rows unchanged. Do not invoke the existing eraAPIs seven-request bundle, which includes blocked private_claim; add a narrow three-request task wrapper using the same public owners.

execute_once_design.owners: Exactly one continuous Go execution for public batched publication and one for local observer publication for the full scenario; exactly one Rust execution per matching mode. No per-shard rerun, no per-record reopen of FinalChain or StateApiEpoch. One independent scheduler capture covers the full interval.
execute_once_design.go: Add a task-owned output sink at the existing eraRun per-period commit point. Flush the period record and sparse full effects immediately. Do not keep a growing periods JSON vector or serialize full history after each period. Use the existing real BeginBlock, transaction execution, DistributeRewards, EndBlock, PrepareCommit and Commit owners unchanged. Keep actual versioned rows for historical reads; output their append/change stream separately.

tape_format.encoding: Versioned fixed-width binary, big-endian integers, manifest hash and reference/mode binding. Digest fields are raw32 bytes; no hex JSON expansion.
fields: canonical exact external period input digest32
tape_format.parent_binding: Record0 prior root is the checked seed root. Each later prior root is the preceding actual final root. Rolling digest binds prior digest, period, prior root, final root, exact input digest, effects digest and sparse-body locator/flags. Final signed-off manifest binds byte counts, last rolling digest and full file SHA256. Cryptographic file binding is fixture authentication, not consensus signing.
tape_format.empty_record: An explicit flag and canonical empty phase arrays can encode an observed empty transcript. Missing fields, missing records, omitted phases and absent bodies with nonempty counts are errors. Equal roots do not imply empty effects.
tape_format.sidecars: Retain full canonical raw effects for EVERY period with nonempty effects, including same-value writes, all ordered phase boundaries, distributions, transactions, receipts/logs and ordinary account/code/storage changes. Dictionary/compression may share exact bytes but must decode losslessly in occurrence order. Retain full boundary API requests/results and exact dynamic external planner facts. The64MiB bound applies to the fixed ledger only; sidecars/history/database have separate measured caps. No promise that all evidence fits64MiB.
tape_format.verification: Hash exact full effect records before discarding in-memory buffers. Rust independently emits actual effects and roots and checks each record. A digest is not a replacement for full nonempty effects retained in sidecars. A complete offline decoder validates counts/offsets/flags/digests, no gaps/duplicates/reordering, both endpoint roots and total163474 records.

execute_once_design.external_inputs: The input tape contains exact block fields, signed transaction bytes, DAG/certificate facts, source reward period indexes, scheduler order and reopen plan. Fixed empty-transaction block templates may be declared once with explicit per-period coordinates. Each dynamic field is supplied in a hashed full input record, never inferred from expected roots. Rust validates the reader-dependent eligibility facts against its own actual delayed state before using them. Scheduler order is an external ordering input, not an expected reward or root result.
execute_once_design.history: Retain each owner actual versioned native/account/code row changes with period/root bindings, including tombstones and absence witnesses. A lossless replayable row-change journal plus fixed seed can replace repeated full physical-map dumps; it must preserve all retained versions and derive boundary snapshots without missing-row defaults. Existing physical readers execute every selected query. Keep durable Rust database snapshots/checkpoints at selected boundaries as admitted, without opening original databases.
execute_once_design.rust: Use the existing bootstrap and ConcreteStateLifecycle, native integration Adapter and native_session owners, StateApiEpoch, request/period_data construction and execute_final_chain_application_task. Add a stream loop at the same level as run_segment_observing (native_integration.rs:611 onward), so chain/application/scheduler/epoch live across all records. Preserve public AccountNodePublication::FinalPeriod and local ObserverHistory modes. Supply period comparison data by lossless sidecar decoding, and compare actual callback effects plus current root after every commit. Do not feed Go native snapshots or expected roots into state execution. Ordinary account/native reads come from the Rust committed reader.
execute_once_design.adapter_changes: Existing historical_workload accepts only fixed scenarios and materialized periods. Do not bypass its guards. Add a separate task-owned named full-duration consumer with exact manifest pins. Existing Adapter fields depend on full per-period comparison records; the implementation must list every field read and provide actual input or authenticated comparison bytes. Missing dynamic fields cannot default to zero or empty. This dependency audit is required before preflight.
execute_once_design.scaling: Do not sweep the whole accumulated history every100 periods. Validate each new committed period/root incrementally, retain every version, and perform one complete indexed history verification plus the boundary reads. This changes task test traversal, not native execution or historical retention.
execute_once_design.scheduler: Run unchanged extracted C++ scheduler once with pinned source/header/storage/compiler/library and native key-order facts. Stream its complete order and pending-set transitions. Bind every payout invocation to exact source periods. Do not synthesize unordered_map order from a formula or clone scheduler runtime state.
execute_once_design.mode_comparison: Keep public/local physical histories and effect sequences separate. Compare their permitted logical results using established comparison contracts; never equate global raw write order. Local observer catalog identities can witness public absence only through the existing explicit no-consumption/no-mutation checks. Full native ledger and scalar/proof/list bytes remain checked per mode.

durability.base_run: Commit every period. After the last period close/reopen the owned Rust application/concrete stores, verify joint committed head/root, empty pending markers, and selected retained readers at P-1,P,E-1,E,E+1,E+5,E+6,E+7. Persist those block/root observations in the final manifest.
durability.lifetime: Do not inject cleanup timers or reset the live owner at tape chunks. If a mid-run close/reopen is required, declare it in both Go and Rust schedules before execution and retain the distinct actual write transcript.
durability.recovery: Full-duration expiry is independent of short-recovery acceptance. Do not claim expiry fault recovery from the old short-policy test. Optional before/after-publication interruption branches at E need separate admission and owned snapshots with scheduler/reopen provenance; not part of this base design.

preflight.purpose: Obtain actual time, RSS, database/history growth and evidence size from the exact execution-once design; this is a finite acceptance preflight, not a performance campaign.
preflight.why: Same checked seed and prefix, proof at5730002, delayed proof visibility, and at least two complete100-period reward cycles. Full jail duration remains163459; preflight does not claim expiry.
preflight.runs: One scheduler capture <=60s; Go public/local and matching Rust public/local sequentially <=300s each. Total runtime upper1260s before separately admitted builds; no automatic retries.
preflight.observe: Record startup time, each100-period batch time, final API/durable-check time, peak RSS, per-phase counts, nonempty effect bytes, input bytes, physical row growth, database growth and retained output bytes. Keep actual raw records and sealed executable/source/config/input hashes.
preflight.full_admission_rule: From complete preflight only, compute a conservative bound per owner: measured startup/final overhead plus3 times the slowest observed100-period batch cost times ceil(163474/100), plus explicitly budgeted boundary API/durable validation. Apply analogous3x per-period growth estimates to sidecars, database and history; account for all owners and copies, scheduler, build and review costs. Source cannot certify linear growth: reject if implementation retains a growing all-period vector, repeats whole-history scans, or measured RSS grows without an acceptable finite full-run cap. Root reviews exact caps and remaining allowance before full execution. Preserve all old18k and other holds within total runtime cap139800; sufficient resources do not waive an admission check.
preflight.failure: Timeout, output/memory/disk cap, incomplete stream, wrong proof, missing schedule or schema mismatch is a retained failure. No throughput extrapolation or successful-prefix expiry claim from a failed preflight. Fix/design review and any new attempt need new finite admission.

acceptance: All four full owner runs complete every163474 period and match actual roots/effects under their named mode contracts.
Proof accepted by both pinned Go owners and Rust with exact native input and delayed membership evidence; jail scalar equals5893461.
Boundary source reader, historical API, estimate and trace scopes all pass without state mutation. Cacti-only individual eligibility and pre-Cacti total-list behavior are distinguished.
EndBlock cleanup at equality, retained jail/proof slots, and later IsJailed false are independently observed.

Every period input, scheduler invocation, root and nonempty ordered effect is retained and authenticated. No state jumps, timer injection, shortened jail, synthetic expected-result installation, omitted history or blocked request lanes.
Complete provenance, sealed executable hashes, command statuses and final durable readers pass independent review. Full expiry evidence is not claimed before this.

source_capture.scope: Only source/meta reads and artifact write; no runtime/build/database opens or repository edits.
